Third-party files, served from here (not from a CDN) so a compromised CDN cannot run code in the admin.

Update: `npm pack <name>@<version>`, copy the file, update the version and hash here.
- CodeMirror 6 + Vim (MIT) — codemirror-md.js, built from `scripts/codemirror-md/` in the Orbiter repo (@codemirror/state 6.7.6, view 6.43.15, commands 6.11.1, language 6.13.1, lang-markdown 6.5.2, lang-html 6.4.12, @lezer/highlight 1.2.5, @replit/codemirror-vim 6.4.0), sha256 4c8a0d1bceef04064a20bb7b79cc9038d896105f51fafd9346d9485670cdfd64. Loaded on demand when the editor switches to the Markdown or HTML view. Rebuild: `cd scripts/codemirror-md && npm install && npm run build`, then copy the file to Lander's `public/vendor/`.
